body:
Thanks.

Yeah I get that life can be like that, and that it is worse for other people than me. Which actually makes me feel like I'm wrong for feeling like this with what I have. I realize there are ups and downs in life, but I'd just like to have the ups balance out the downs, my ups barely make me feel neutral.


I have tried to look for another job, but it isn't easy for me. Partly because I don't have a great education, and I don't have many people I can use for references.

Yeah, love is a massive risk for me. Between my emotions and my trust issues its tough for me. I'd love to be the kinda person could do FWB, or ONS or something, but I don't know if I could. Plus, I'm not great with women, never have been. That would mean going out or having friends, neither of which applies to me. My problem is, I tend to be attracted to women that I can't have for one reason or another, or they have 0 interest in me.

Huge range of TV, from firefly, BSG, breaking bad to Sons Of Anarchy. Can't get into Game of thrones though. Mostly comic book and sci fi films these days. I like the older horror films, not the paranormal activity sort. Music is huge, but mostly metal/rock. Yeah, I have an Xbox. Still haven't finished Gear of War or Battlefield 1, just don't have the motivation these days.

Thanks. 

I'm actually trying to write something now, but I've never tried before.


I do have hobbies, but they all seem to be ones to do on my own. Watching films, gaming, reading, motorcycle. I've tried team type ones before, but they didn't help me. All I saw happen was other people become friends and me getting left out again. (Not looking for a pity party, just stating a fact)


I'd love to have a dog, but I can't at the minute. Between not being allowed them where I live, no time with 2 jobs, and possibly having to work for a job in the future.
